highlights: D itto, an AI matchmaking service for college students, has raised $9.2 million in seed funding to replace swipe-based dating apps with a weekly algorithmic pairing delivered over iMessage. The company, founded by UC Berkeley dropouts Allen Wang and Eric Liu, has attracted 150,000 signups across a few dozen colleges, and Wang says roughly 20% of matches end up going on an in-person date. Investors on the round include Gradient, Peak XV, and Scribble.
